Situation Report — Day 27

  • Diplomacy / Pauses: Trump announced a SECOND pause on strikes against Iranian energy (10 days; deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), claiming Iran requested it and talks are "going very well." Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. Tactical context: first 5‑day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.

  • Civil incident: Bystanders rescued an 11‑year‑old girl from a kidnapping attempt in central Israel.
  • International / Shipping: Iran continues selective Hormuz passage for friendly states (Russia, India, China). No new global military deployments reported in the last 30 minutes.
  • 🟢 Good News: Arrests after the mosque shooting. Child rescued from kidnapping. Pause announcement may temporarily reduce strikes.
  • Threat assessment: escalating
